title: Tableau block indices
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $n$ and $t$ be natural numbers. The tableau block is the list of vertex indices, in order, for bits $j=0,\ldots,B-1$, where $B$ is the number of bits used to encode a snapshot and each index is the tableau vertex for bit $j$ in block $t$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
